verdict.rationale: Justworks is a PEO and payroll platform, so proactive compliance alerts are a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of alerts triggered by a new hire, a new work location, or a law change. The cited items cover manual payroll checks, fringe-benefit recording, time-off setup, automatic holiday designation and Xero mapping, none of which are proactive compliance-obligation notifications.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get proactive alerts when a new hire, location, or law change creates a compliance obligation
